sources.snippet: This repository provides a script for predicting future stock prices using an LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) neural network model. The script utilizes historical stock price data, scales it for optimal LSTM training, builds or loads a cached LSTM model, and predicts future prices. It is designed to handle multiple stock tickers and can process predictions in parallel.
